title: Relationship
description: A typed directed edge between any two Context Fabric entities: edition supersedes edition, edition translation-of edition, node aligned-with node (versification mapping), node cites work, annotation derived-from asset.

kind.description: Well-known kinds: 'supersedes', 'translation-of', 'aligned-with', 'cites', 'derived-from', 'cross-reference'. Custom kinds must be namespaced ('myapp:parallel-passage').
